metadata.description: Personal home-infrastructure toolkit — LAN discovery + troubleshooting and Bitwarden CLI credential workflows. Two skills that often work together (e.g., capturing a device password into the vault during a network onboarding session).

plugins.name: home-network
plugins.description: Home LAN discovery + troubleshooting with self-healing knowledge capture. mDNS/ARP/TCP probing, ufw recipes, device inventory that grows via background `claude -p` agents. Includes home-net-learn (per-device) and home-net-capture (general findings) write-back loops.

plugins.name: bitwarden-cli
plugins.description: Patterns for using the Bitwarden CLI (`bw`) — secure note creation, item lookup, the self-destructing handoff script pattern for storing secrets generated by another process (Claude, automation) into the user's vault without ever seeing the master password.
